description_en: Creates a new thread under a specified DataAgent and returns the ID of the new thread
description_zh: 在指定的 DataAgent 下创建一个新的会话，并返回新会话的 ID
name: CreateThread

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent under which the thread is created
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定在哪个 DataAgent 下创建会话
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The custom attributes of the thread. Both keys and values are strings. You can use them to tag the thread or carry business context
parameters.help_zh: 会话的自定义属性，键与值均为字符串，可用于标记会话或携带业务上下文
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.help_en: The title of the thread. You do not need to specify this parameter when creating a thread. The service automatically generates and maintains the thread title based on the conversation content. To customize the title, call UpdateThread after the thread is created
parameters.help_zh: 会话标题。创建时无需传入：会话标题由服务根据对话内容自动生成与维护，如需自定义请在会话创建后调用 UpdateThread 修改
parameters.name: title

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project associated with the thread
fields.help_zh: 会话关联的日志服务 Project 名称
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The name of the workspace associated with the thread
fields.help_zh: 会话关联的工作空间（Workspace）名称
fields.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The context variables of the thread, which are used to restrict the thread to a specified Simple Log Service resource scope
parameters.help_zh: 会话的上下文变量，用于把会话限定在指定的日志服务资源范围内
parameters.name: variables

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the identifier of the newly created thread
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回新建会话的标识

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

threadId.description_en: The ID of the newly created thread. Use this ID for subsequent operations such as initiating a conversation (CreateChat), querying, modifying, or deleting the thread
threadId.description_zh: 新建会话的 ID。后续发起对话（CreateChat）以及查询、修改、删除该会话时都使用它

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. The initial configuration of the new thread. All fields are optional
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。新会话的初始配置，所有字段均可省略
v1_body_parameters.name: body
